A Russian S-400 air defence system launcher was reportedly destroyed in Bryansk Oblast, ~90 km from Ukrainian border.

The launcher was allegedly modified to fire RM-48U ballistic missiles, recently used in strikes on Kyiv. 

Ukrainian intelligence claims up to 17 S-400 launchers

But we need to be mature partners.

We focus on the most important thing: We are friends, and
